# Catalog models whose price moves when every graph node's Role is renamed to a string nothing
# compares with (design SUB-20). TestChangingALabelChangesNoPriceOrIsListed renames the role of
# every node, rewrites every reference to it, and prices the model again on every chip and layout
# the perturbation tries. A model listed here has a price that depends on a label.
# The list may only shrink: the test fails on a model not listed and on a listed model whose price
# no longer moves.
#
# It is empty. The cost model reads holds_engine_kv and shared, which the deriver sets, and the
# graph's context.decode_extent; it reads no label.
